truth_cards.title: It's a loan, not a grant
truth_cards.description: Tuition is paid to university. Maintenance is paid to you.

truth_cards.title: You only repay above £25,000
truth_cards.description: Repayment is based on income, not the balance.

truth_cards.title: Wiped after 30 / 40 years
truth_cards.description: Many graduates do not repay the full amount.

faq_card.title: Is YStudy really free?
faq_card.description: Yes — guidance, tools and adviser support are always free. We're funded by partner universities, not by you.

faq_card.title: Am I too old to study?
faq_card.description: No. Our courses are built for adult learners and career changers — many students are 25, 35, 45+.

faq_card.title: Do I need existing qualifications?
